001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity;
002
003import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
004import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
005import androidx.room.Entity;
006import androidx.room.Index;
007import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
008import java.time.Instant;
009
010/**
011 * The {@code User} class represents a user entity in the application's database.
012 * It is annotated with {@code @Entity} to map this class to the "user" table
013 * in the SQLite database. The table includes an index on the "oauth_key" column,
014 * ensuring unique values for that key.
015 *
016 * The class defines the following main fields:
017 * - {@code id}: A unique identifier for each user, auto-generated when a user record is created.
018 * - {@code displayName}: The display name of the user, stored as a case-insensitive value.
019 * - {@code oauthKey}: A unique identifier for OAuth authentication, stored as a case-insensitive value.
020 * - {@code created}: A timestamp indicating when the user entity was created.
021 *
022 * Getters and setters are provided for accessing and modifying each of these fields.
023 *
024 * This class is designed to work seamlessly with Room for database management.
025 */
026@Entity(
027    tableName = "user",
028    indices = {
029        @Index(value = "oauth_key", unique = true)
030    }
031)
032public class User {
033
034  /**
035   * Unique identifier for a {@code User} entity. This identifier serves as the primary key
036   * for the "user" table in the application's database. The value is auto-generated when
037   * a new user record is created, ensuring uniqueness for each user.
038   */
039  @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
040  @ColumnInfo(name = "user_id")
041  private long id;
042
043  /**
044   * Stores the display name of a {@code User}. This field is case-insensitive and is annotated
045   * for storage in the database with the column name "display_name". It is guaranteed to be
046   * non-null, and its default value is an empty string. This field is used to represent how
047   * a {@code User} is publicly displayed or referenced.
048   */
049  @ColumnInfo(name = "display_name", collate = ColumnInfo.NOCASE)
050  @NonNull
051  private String displayName = "";
052
053  /**
054   * Represents the OAuth authentication key associated with a {@code User}.
055   * This field is stored as a case-insensitive string in the database under
056   * the column name "oauth_key". It is a required, non-null value and has
057   * a default of an empty string.
058   *
059   * The "oauth_key" column is indexed to ensure unique values, which helps
060   * identify users during authentication processes.
061   */
062  @ColumnInfo(name = "oauth_key", collate = ColumnInfo.NOCASE)
063  @NonNull
064  private String oauthKey = "";
065
066  /**
067   * Stores the timestamp representing the creation date and time of the {@code User} entity.
068   * This field is initialized to the current system time when a {@code User} instance is created.
069   * The value is immutable and non-null to ensure that a creation time is always assigned.
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  private Instant created = Instant.now();
073
074  public long getId() {
075    return id;
076  }
077
078
079  public void setId(long id) {
080    this.id = id;
081  }
082
083  @NonNull
084  public String getDisplayName() {
085    return displayName;
086  }
087
088  public void setDisplayName(@NonNull String displayName) {
089    this.displayName = displayName;
090  }
091
092  @NonNull
093  public String getOauthKey() {
094    return oauthKey;
095  }
096
097  public void setOauthKey(@NonNull String oauthKey) {
098    this.oauthKey = oauthKey;
099  }
100
101  @NonNull
102  public Instant getCreated() {
103    return created;
104  }
105
106  public void setCreated(@NonNull Instant created) {
107    this.created = created;
108  }
109}
